rewrites.comment: Client-side routing. Every path is a real URL to React Router but only / is a real file, so a direct hit or a reload on /arcade or /roster 404s without this. Rewrites run after the filesystem check, so /og.png, /arcade-game.html, the manifest and the hashed assets are still served as themselves.

headers.comment: Vite content-hashes these, so a change is a new filename and the old one can be cached forever.
The game and the shell are not hashed, so they have to be revalidated or a build can strand people on the old one.
